OR % 18.12.2023 CRL.M.A. 34722/2023 (exemption)
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. Application stands disposed of.

3. This petition has been filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C on behalf of the Petitioner seeking quashing of FIR No. 366/2023 dated 04.06.2023 registered under Sections 328/376/377/506 IPC at P.S.
North Rohini, premised on a settlement arrived at between the Petitioner and Respondent No.2 incorporating the terms of settlement.
It is stated that the parties have reconciled all their differences and are now living together.
4. Complainant is appearing through video conferencing and is identified by the Investigating Officer SI Sanju, P.S. North Rohini.
